description: Flags pinned dependencies in a repository's requirements.txt, package-lock.json, or uv.lock published more recently than a freshness threshold -- a supply-chain-compromise tripwire. Free CLI (requirements.txt/package-lock.json only, uv.lock support pending there): github.com/sbakhour/freshdep.

ref.description: Optional branch/tag to check out instead of the default branch.

threshold_days.description: Flag anything published more recently than this many days ago. Defaults to 7.

name: post_freshdep_scan
